## Methods and technical skills

- **Statistical modelling:** linear, logit, multinomial and ordinal regression models
- **Machine learning:** supervised and unsupervised classification 
- **Survey microdata:** 2021 Census of Population, General Social Survey - Time Use (1986-2021) and National Survey on Transport Poverty, through the Statistics Canada Research Data Centre
- **Programming and reproducible research:** R (package development: AmazonULC, ActiveCA, CommuteCA), Python, literate programming
- **GIS and remote sensing:** QGIS; geographic object-based image analysis (GEOBIA); segmentation
